create.title: Hierarchical beta partition and recombined radial split
create.statement_tex: With the hierarchical partition 1=psi(beta)+(1-psi(beta))psi(alpha)+(1-psi(beta))(1-psi(alpha)), the beta branch owns the complete double-bounded box. Its internal split psi(beta)=psi(beta)psi(alpha)+psi(beta)(1-psi(alpha)) has cancelling psi'(alpha) connector edges and complementary A=0 residue weights summing to one. The finite Cauchy-Green displacement is applied first to G=E1+R1, whose apparent rho=0 residues cancel. If omega(-Im rho)=1 near rho=0, then after the complete same-mask E1 endpoint image is removed the exact survivor is R1=omega G+(1-omega)R1-omega E1. The omega' connectors cancel by G-E1-R1=0; the artificial residue, full A=0 residue, all actual profiles, floors, stars, finite sides, and the external -(4/pi)X^(1/4) real-part normalization are retained exactly. This is an identity and supplies no estimate for the double-bounded or transition kernels.

create.title: Separated post-endpoint beta radial q-inverse and signed top gain
create.statement_tex: For the post-endpoint remainder R1=-(pi i sqrt(X)/rho)I1(rho), let alpha_0=pi q sqrt(Xx)/D_j. On a positive-alpha stationary patch with bounded beta, fixed b=Re(v)>0, and positive separation from saddle entry, saddle exit, and the artificial rho=0 seam, 1/rho=2i/alpha_0+O((1+|beta+nu|)/alpha_0^2). Thus R1 has one inverse q relative to the q^0 unsplit G stationary transform. For the hard top, after the symmetric physical split (a+i mu)^(-1)=pi delta_0(mu)-i PV(1/mu), the signed two-denominator nu convolution satisfies C_PV=O_b(alpha_0^(-2)) and C_delta=O_b(alpha_0^(-4)). Restoring the R1 stationary numerator gives O_b(D_j/(q alpha_0))=O_b(D_j/(q^2 theta_j(x))). The constants cost only polylogarithms on b=1/log(2X). This lemma excludes transition zones, the artificial-pole seam, the double-bounded share, full scale/height/radial sums, endpoints, and finite outside-height limits.
create.next_action: Prove a uniform stationary-transition decomposition that preserves the signed top gain through entry and exit, then execute the complete dyadic, height, radial, endpoint, and side sums.

update.title: Unsplit beta stationary character kernel and post-endpoint scope
update.statement_tex: In the positive-alpha interior, partial_alpha Psi=log(alpha D_j/(pi q sqrt(Xx))), alpha_0=pi q sqrt(Xx)/D_j, and |Psi''(alpha_0)|=alpha_0^(-1). For the unsplit radial transform G=E1+R1, the gamma, arithmetic, and stationary powers leave exactly q^0 with leading phase exp(-iq theta_j(x)). Its finite period-four character Dirichlet kernel has maximal pointwise envelope min(Q,1+|cos theta|^(-1)), one-period L1 norm O(log(2Q)), and the standard discrete-BV Abel bound; the hard-top half-integer parity gap also holds. This q^0 statement does not apply to separated post-endpoint R1, whose explicit 1/rho gives q^(-1) on a separated saddle and whose signed hard-top convolution is recorded separately. The character-kernel facts alone do not prove phase-pushforward density, profile BV, transitions, endpoints, or outside-height limits.
